title: Dr. Tox: Altrulan
series: Dr. Tox: Age of Glass & Greed, episode 4 of 4 (dr-tox-rise, dr-tox-fall, dr-tox-finale, dr-tox-altrulan)
sources: dr-tox/source/Dr_Tox_Compiled_Bible_Obsidian.md (not in the vault; cited by part and section)
structure: The Epic of Altrulan, the bible's second phase (Part I): one pilgrimage in the seventh year of the Breath, from Snakehead, the holy cave, by the Glass Mountains and the breathing city to the Light Bringer's shrine. A new lead, the pilgrim-keeper Hesper Quaye, with the Ghost as companion. People of the earlier episodes appear only as the scripture remembers them. It plays from the Finale's Reset and First Word; the Finale's last flags arrive as myth (who is remembered as what), never as a changed premise. Green Wins closes the save: no Altrulan follows it. Whether it follows The Cage Holds and The Light Bringer's Wall is the author's open question (DESIGN.md section 20).
